3333233f401c.title_raw: IT Co-op Student Fall 2026***Étudiant Co-op TI, Automone 2026
3333233f401c.description_html:
IPEX est l’un des principaux fournisseurs de systèmes intégrés de tuyauteries thermoplastiques en Amérique du Nord. Nous avons pour mission de bâtir un avenir meilleur en connectant les gens avec l’eau et l’énergie.

Nous avons présentement une opportunité en tant qu”Étudiant Co-op TI, Automone 2026. Ce rôle est basé à notre bureau de Verdun et relève du Gestionnaire, sécurité des infrastructures.

Ne manquez pas l’opportunité de joindre une grande famille de professionnels centrée sur les gens, leaders à l’esprit agile, entrepreneurs dans l’âme qui aiment défier le statu quo.


Description du poste

En tant qu’étudiant en stage coopératif au poste d’analyste en sécurité des infrastructures, vous travaillerez aux côtés des membres de l’équipe de sécurité des infrastructures et participerez à des projets liés à la sécurité des réseaux, à l’architecture des infrastructures, à la gestion des identités et à la protection des infrastructures.

Vous apprendrez comment les environnements d’entreprise sont conçus, sécurisés, documentés et pris en charge, tout en contribuant à de véritables initiatives professionnelles.

Activités principales

  • Contribuer à la documentation des solutions de sécurité des infrastructures et des réseaux.
  • Appuyer les projets liés à la sécurité et à l’architecture des infrastructures sous la supervision des membres de l’équipe.
  • Contribuer à la création et à la mise à jour des schémas de réseau, des procédures et de la documentation technique.
  • Participer aux examens des pare-feu et aux activités d’amélioration de la sécurité des réseaux.
  • Contribuer aux tests de connectivité et à la validation des exigences de sécurité.
  • Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe pour analyser et résoudre les problèmes de base liés aux réseaux ou à la sécurité.
  • Découvrez les normes de sécurité d’entreprise, les mesures de contrôle et les pratiques de conception d’infrastructure.
  • Appuyez les initiatives en matière de gestion des identités et des accès.
  • Familiarisez-vous avec les solutions de gestion des accès privilégiés, telles que CyberArk.
  • Effectuez des recherches sur les technologies et partagez vos conclusions utiles avec l’équipe.
  • Collaborez avec vos collègues des équipes chargées de l’infrastructure, des réseaux, du nuage et de la sécurité dans le cadre des initiatives de l’équipe.

Connaissances et compétences nécessaires

  • Génie, réseaux, systèmes d’information ou un domaine connexe.
  • Connaissances de base, de niveau étudiant, des principes fondamentaux des réseaux, tels que TCP/IP, DNS, le routage, la commutation et le dépannage des réseaux.
  • Intérêt pour la technologie, les infrastructures et la sécurité.
  • Volonté d’apprendre de nouveaux outils et concepts techniques.
  • Bonnes aptitudes analytiques et capacité à résoudre des problèmes.
  • Bonnes aptitudes en communication, en organisation et en travail d’équipe.
  • Capacité à suivre des directives, à documenter son travail et à poser des questions lorsqu’on a besoin d’aide.
  • DIsponible au moins 24hrs par semaine, de Octobre à Décembre 2026

Atouts – utiles, mais non obligatoire

  • Cours, travaux pratiques, projet personnel ou expérience professionnelle en lien avec la sécurité des réseaux.
  • Connaissance des technologies ou des concepts liés aux pare-feu.
  • Compréhension de la gestion des identités et des accès (IAM).
  • Connaissances de base d’Active Directory, de l’authentification ou de l’authentification à facteurs multiples.
  • Connaissance de la gestion des accès privilégiés (PAM).
  • Connaissance de CyberArk.
  • Connaissance des plateformes en nuage ou des concepts liés à la sécurité dans le nuage.
  • Expérience avec PowerShell, Python ou un autre langage de script.

IPEX fait tout son possible pour répondre aux besoins d’accommodement des personnes handicapées durant tout le processus d’entrevue et, sur demande, collaborera avec les candidats qualifiés pour leur offrir des mesures d’accommodement convenables de façon à prendre en compte leurs besoins en matière d’accessibilité découlant de leur handicap. Les candidats participant à toutes les étapes du processus de sélection en vue d’un emploi à IPEX peuvent demander des mesures d’accommodement. Pour faire une demande, veuillez communiquer avec les RH à HR@ipexna.com

____________________________________________________________________________


IPEX is one of North America’s leading providers of integrated thermoplastic piping systems. Our mission is to build a better future by connecting people to water and energy.


We currently have an opening for an IT Co-op Student, Fall 2026.

This role is based at our Verdun office and reports to the Infrastructure Security Manager.


Don't miss the opportunity to join a large, people-centered family of professionals—agile-minded leaders and entrepreneurs at heart who love to challenge the status quo.


Job Description

As a co-op student in the role of Infrastructure Security Analyst, you will work alongside members of the infrastructure security team and participate in projects related to network security, infrastructure architecture, identity management, and infrastructure protection.


You will learn how enterprise environments are designed, secured, documented, and supported, while contributing to real-world business initiatives.


Main Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the documentation of infrastructure and network security solutions.
  • Support projects related to infrastructure security and architecture under the supervision of team members.
  • Help create and update network diagrams, procedures, and technical documentation.
  • Participate in firewall reviews and activities to improve network security.
  • Contribute to connectivity testing and the validation of security requirements.
  • Collaborate with team members to analyze and resolve basic network or security issues.
  • Learn about corporate security standards, controls, and infrastructure design practices.
  • Support identity and access management initiatives.
  • Familiarize yourself with privileged access management solutions, such as CyberArk.
  • Research technologies and share useful findings with the team.
  • Collaborate with colleagues on the infrastructure, networking, cloud, and security teams as part of team initiatives.

Required Knowledge and Skills


  • Currently enrolled in a college or university program in Information Technology, Computer Science, ComputerEngineering, Networking, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Basic student-level understanding of networking fundamentals, such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, and networktroubleshooting
  • Engineering, networking, information systems, or a related field.
  • Interest in technology, infrastructure, and security.
  • Willingness to learn new tools and technical concepts.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication, organization, and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to follow guidance, document work, and ask questions when support is needed.
  • Available at least 24 hrs/wek, from October to December 2026

Assets - helpful, but not required

  • Coursework, a lab, personal project, or work exposure related to network security.
  • Familiarity with firewall technologies or firewall concepts.
  • Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM).
  • Basic knowledge of Active Directory, authentication, or Multi-Factor Authentication.
  • Exposure to Privileged Access Management (PAM).
  • Familiarity with CyberArk.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms or cloud security concepts.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Python, or another scripting langua

IPEX is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process and, upon request, will work with qualified job applicants to provide suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability. Accommodation requests are available to candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process for IPEX jobs. To request an accommodation, please contact HR at askhr@ipexna.com

33db1d5aebc8.title: IS/IT Intern - Summer 2027

location.raw: Franklin, Tennessee - United States of America

33db1d5aebc8.description_html:
Location(s): Franklin, TN
Job Schedule: Full-time, 12-week program
Degree Level: Junior or Senior
Preferred Degree: Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or related technical field
Sponsorship: Not Available


Shape the Future of Mobility at Nissan: Launch Your Career, Drive Innovation


We are currently looking for an IS/IT Intern to join our team in Franklin, TN. This role supports Supply Chain systems for Manufacturing and Service Parts operations across the Americas. Our technology landscape ranges from legacy platforms to modern cloud and SaaS solutions, providing interns with the opportunity to gain hands-on experience supporting critical business systems that serve 35 facilities throughout the region. If you are interested in technology, problem solving, and helping drive business improvements through innovative solutions, this internship offers valuable real-world experience.


A Day in the Life:

  • Support modernization initiatives and technology enhancement projects across Supply Chain systems.
  • Translate business requirements into technical requirements and assist with solution development.
  • Identify and evaluate automation opportunities to improve system efficiency and business processes.
  • Analyze business gaps and recommend technology-driven solutions.
  • Collaborate with business and IT teams to support ongoing system improvements and operational needs.

Who We’re Looking for:

Required:

  • Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
  • Students entering their Junior or Senior year at the start of the upcoming academic term.
  • Interest in problem solving and applying technology to business challenges.
  • Basic understanding of system architecture, APIs, and system integrations.
  • Basic understanding of coding principles and software development concepts.
  • Interest in emerging technologies such as AI, data, analytics, and automation.
  • GPA of 3.0 or above (Candidates will be required to provide an official or unofficial transcript during the application process for verification.)
  • Ability to perform work onsite at Franklin, TN.

What You’ll Look Forward to at Nissan:

Connection and Collaboration: We offer Business Synergy Teams (ERGs) and opportunities for our employees to strengthen their relationships and meet people from similar and diverse backgrounds to foster a culture of belonging.


Professional Training and Development: Expand your knowledge and skills through Nissan’s rich innovation offerings, seminars, learning platforms and leadership trainings.


Nissan is committed to a drug-free workplace. All employment is contingent upon the successful completion of drug and background screenings in accordance with Nissan policies and in compliance with federal, state, and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance. Nissan will consider qualified candidates with arrest or conviction records for employment in a manner consistent with these laws.


It is Nissan’s policy to provide Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, gender, military status, disability, or any other status protected by law. Candidates for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility at the time of hire; Nissan uses E-Verify to validate employment eligibility.


NISSAN FOR EVERYONE


People are our most valuable assets, and Nissan seeks to maximize the power of each individual member of our team. When everyone belongs, the power of NISSAN is undeniable. Nissan aims to improve business results through a workplace and business that meets the needs of our employees and customer base.


Nissan is committed to creating a culture where everyone belongs and employees, customers, and partners feel respected, valued, and heard. We have Business Synergy Teams (BSTs) across the Americas that are open to all employees and seek to connect employees through common interests and foster a company culture where all employees feel supported and included.


Nissan also values inclusion in our business as we respect and recognize the diversity of our customer base and the communities where we do business. We are committed to procuring innovative goods and services, retailing our products, and communicating from a position that will help us continue to offer our customers competitively designed, market-driven products.


Join us as we carry our commitment to our employees and customers into the future.


Franklin Tennessee United States of America

33e0b2f9f565.title: Aircraft Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
33e0b2f9f565.description_html:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

READ THIS PART FIRST

An aircraft internship should involve more than updating drawings. You should be able to point to hardware and explain what you changed, why you changed it, and what happened when it was built or tested.

WHAT WE DO

Swarm Aero is redefining air power. We are building autonomous aircraft and Legion, command and control software designed to coordinate large numbers of heterogeneous autonomous systems. Our team combines experience building novel aircraft, scaling startups, and delivering technology for national security.

THE INTERNSHIP

You will own a scoped project with a clear technical or business outcome, work directly with the people responsible for the system, and present what you built and learned at the end of the summer. The goal is not to give you practice work. It is to give you useful work with the support to do it well.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

· Design primary or secondary aircraft structure, mechanisms, brackets, routed-system supports, or other flight hardware

· Create and revise 3D models, drawings, and bills of material using sound GD&T practices

· Support structural analysis, trade studies, tolerance work, mass-property estimates, or design reviews

· Work with manufacturing and suppliers to resolve producibility, assembly, and inspection issues

· Support component, structural, ground, or flight-test preparation and use the results to improve the design

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

· Currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related field, with graduation and enrollment requirements to be confirmed.

· Experience with a CAD package such as NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, Creo, or Fusion 360

· Fundamentals in statics, mechanics of materials, machine design, materials, and manufacturing

· Evidence that you build things through a design team, Formula SAE, rocketry, UAVs, research, a machine shop, or personal projects

WHAT SETS YOU APART

· Composite or metallic aircraft structures

· FEA tools such as Nastran, Abaqus, Ansys, or HyperMesh

· Mechanisms, actuation, thermal, fluids, propulsion integration, or routed systems

· GD&T, drawing release, machining, composites, or test experience

WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED

Aerospace experience, a perfect GPA, or a previous internship at a famous company. Show us what you have built, analyzed, tested, organized, or improved, and be ready to explain your contribution clearly.

THE HONEST VERSION

The pace is fast, the problems will not arrive fully defined, and you may spend part of the summer learning why your first approach was wrong. We will expect you to ask questions, test your assumptions, document your work, and leave the project better than you found it.

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems
